items.description: query parameter and stored display name written into an HTML response without escaping
order read by id with no check that it belongs to the signed-in user
status and sort query parameters concatenated into a SQL string
name query parameter joined to the upload directory and read without a containment check
role change route lacks the admin check every other admin route has, so any signed-in user can make themselves admin
export format from the request body flows into a shell command through a template string
hardcoded signing secret for session tokens
server posts to a URL taken from the request body with no destination check

decoys.description: avatar route joins the name through safeJoin, which checks containment
product search with a parameterised LIKE
payment webhook verifies an HMAC with a constant-time compare
cancel route checks the order belongs to the user
